title: Agitavit owns an eHRM product and has too little evidence to rank
content:
Agitavit Solutions is a small Slovenian firm whose only recorded stack is its own eHRM product, and the assessment describes the evidence as thin. Owning a product is normally the signal that counts against a lead in this set, because a firm's own application occupies the layer a partnership would need.

The honest position here is not a judgement, though — it is an absence. Nothing in the record says whether the eHRM product is the whole business or one line among several. The lead sits at priority 4, needs OSS screen, which is the right place for an entry whose file contains a product name and a size adjective.
